semantic.notes: Raw topic end offsets. Values cover every producer that appends to the ingress topic; they are not API-only accepted counts.
Raw committed offsets. A commit can follow persistence, an idempotency hit, rejection, or terminal DLQ handling.
Raw per-partition lag. Negative exporter sentinels are retained and must not be included as zero by this collector.
Counts success, rejected, and DLQ outcomes after Kafka offset commit. The failure outcome is excluded because it is rewound without offset commit. This is not PostgreSQL commit or insert rate.
Measures API queued_at before Kafka append to Worker handler start and includes Kafka publish time.
Measures payload queued_at to the timestamp refreshed after PostgreSQL commit returns. It includes queueing and processing and is not isolated PostgreSQL commit latency.
Measures _persist_message_with_cursor only. It excludes request status work and the enclosing transaction commit.
